title: Anomali
description: Contract 3 — the anomaly engine's output, owned by track B and consumed by the dashboard, the alarm service and the Modbus map. As long as this shape holds, the detector behind it may be a threshold rule or a model; that is what lets the method decision stay open.

id.description: Stable anomaly identifier, unique across the system.

zaman.description: Time of the measurement that triggered the anomaly, not the time the detector ran. UTC ISO 8601 with a literal Z.

skor.description: Confidence / severity score, 0..1. Used for ranking within a seviye, not for deciding it.

seviye.description: Severity, ordered normal < izle < uyari < kritik. This is the field the alarm service and the SCADA register map act on.

tip.description: Which fault scenario this is. sensor_arizasi and modul_saglik are system self-health, not grid faults. asiri_yuk is the overload diagnosis, distinct from the single-terminal sicak_nokta.

gerekce.description: Human-readable reason, in Turkish, shown to the operator verbatim. Mandatory and non-empty: an operator who cannot see why an alarm fired stops trusting the system and turns it off.
examples: L2 cikis klemensi 34 dk icinde +18 C yukseldi, akim sabit kaldi.

kanit.description: Machine-readable evidence backing gerekce. Open-ended on purpose — different detector types point at different things — but the known keys below are reserved and must keep these shapes.

kare_id.description: Thermal frame in the termal_kare table that the dashboard should render.

piksel.description: Pixel to highlight on that frame as [sutun, satir].

olcum_tipi.description: Measurement type to plot alongside the anomaly.

pencere.description: Time window the detector looked at, as [bas, bit].

esik.description: Threshold that was crossed, in the measurement's own unit.

olculen.description: Value that crossed it, in the measurement's own unit.

durum.description: Operator-driven lifecycle. 'acik' on creation; the read API's onayla endpoint moves it to 'onaylandi'; 'kapandi' when the condition is gone or the work order is finished.

examples.gerekce: L2 cikis klemensi 34 dk icinde +18 C yukseldi, akim sabit kaldi.
